title: David Choe Talks About Placebo Effect, Faith, and the Power of the Mind-Body Connection
description: Choe considers truth, fiction, placebo and faith as forces that can change bodies and behavior, contrasting his blunt style with trickster methods before arguing that creativity and mind-body effects exceed tidy logical explanation.
